items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Then I had a band there for about six months with Georgie Auld. We had a band.

ctx.x: And I'd get the band together, go there with Gloria Lynn. Then I had a band there for about six months with Georgie Auld. We had a band. I stayed around Vegas for about two, three years, you know, Las Vegas. In fact, I got married in Las Vegas, and my daughter was born in 1965 and naturally, if you're going to make a future for kids, you can't be as rambunctious as you were when you were single.
